text: New open-source speech model runs real-time transcription on a laptop CPU at 80ms latency. No GPU required. Removes a big cost barrier for voice apps that previously needed dedicated H100 inference.

Leaked benchmark suggests the new frontier model hits 92% on the agentic coding eval, up from 78%. Unverified, single source. If it holds, the gap to closed models on long-horizon tasks is closing fast.
A startup shipped a tool that turns plain-English specs into typed API clients across 6 languages. Early users report cutting integration time from days to under an hour for standard REST endpoints.

New paper: training small models on the reasoning traces of large ones matches 80% of the teacher's accuracy at 5% of the inference cost. The distinction that matters is trace quality, not trace volume.

Watching teams replace their first support hire with an agent that drafts replies and escalates edge cases. The winners pair it with a tight human review loop, not full automation. Trust is the bottleneck, not capability.
